h1: Heart of Harmony Amenities: Complete Guide to 40+ Facilities at Kudlu Gate, Bengaluru

blocks.text: H eart of Harmony amenities span 40+ curated facilities across two distinct levels — the vehicle-free podium at ground level and the rooftop terrace clubhouse. Whether you are evaluating this project for the first time or comparing it to alternatives on Hosur Road, Bengaluru, this guide covers every facility across wellness, sports, social, children’s zones, and everyday convenience.

CKPC Heart of Harmony has designed these amenities around a single principle: 137 homes sharing premium facilities delivers a fundamentally better experience than 500 homes sharing the same space. With only 6 homes per floor, the clubhouse and outdoor facilities are never overcrowded — your pool, your gym, your garden are genuinely yours to enjoy.

blocks.text: Sports & Active Amenities

At Heart of Harmony, recreation, wellness, and community interaction are seamlessly integrated into everyday living. Rather than isolated amenities, the project distributes them across the site, creating spaces that feel intuitive, accessible, and naturally woven into daily routines.

The sports infrastructure is designed to support both active lifestyles and casual engagement. Jogging and cycling tracks run through the landscape, encouraging movement at all times of the day, along with dedicated zones for the multipurpose court, basketball practice court, and pickleball court. For more immersive fitness experiences, the indoor gym and rock climbing wall add variety, complemented by quieter outdoor settings such as the yoga and meditation lawn, where wellness takes on a slower, more mindful pace.
Social & Community Spaces

Social life at Heart of Harmony is equally well-considered, with spaces that accommodate everything from large gatherings to informal interactions. The banquet hall with an attached kitchen enables hosted events, while the amphitheatre and multipurpose rooms create opportunities for community-led activities. More relaxed settings like the sky deck, sunken seating with a campfire, and shaded plazas offer residents places to unwind, connect, or spend time outdoors.
To explore the full lifestyle experience that these social spaces are part of, see lifestyle and community at Heart of Harmony.
Wellness & Relaxation

Leisure amenities are curated to provide a sense of retreat outside the homes. The swimming pool, paired with a spa, sauna, and jacuzzi, introduces a resort-like quality, while elements such as the star-gazing deck, reflexology path, and sculpture court add layers of sensory and experiential engagement. Walkways and nature trails further reinforce this connection to landscape, making leisure less about activity and more about the atmosphere.

The rooftop clubhouse position ensures the swimming pool and wellness suite enjoy panoramic views across South Bengaluru’s skyline — a setting that no mid-rise or at-grade clubhouse can replicate. To understand how the rooftop level fits within the full master plan design, read Heart of Harmony master plan and site layout .
Children’s Spaces & Family Amenities

Children’s spaces are designed with equal attention, ensuring that they have dedicated areas that are both safe and engaging. From a kid’s pool and play area to a thoughtfully included pet park, these zones support a more inclusive, family-oriented environment. What ties all of this together is a strong emphasis on everyday convenience. Features like co-working spaces, provision for retail kiosks, and dedicated family-friendly utilities such as feeding and diaper changing rooms acknowledge the realities of modern living, making the development not just aspirational but highly functional.
In essence, Heart of Harmony is designed to support a balanced, community-driven lifestyle where recreation, wellness, and connection coexist effortlessly.
Podium Level vs Rooftop Clubhouse — How Amenities Are Organised

Heart of Harmony’s amenities are spread across two levels rather than concentrated in one area. This two-level distribution is a deliberate master plan decision — one that ensures active and social amenities are always accessible at grade, while premium wellness facilities are reserved for the elevated rooftop setting.

rows: Sky deck swimming pool (paddle + lazy pool)
Children’s play area and tot lot

blocks.text: The podium is a vehicle-free zone — no cars, no parking ramps, no service traffic. Residents step out of the lobby and into greenery. The rooftop clubhouse, positioned 24 floors above the city, turns every pool session and gym visit into a skyline experience that standard at-grade clubhouses simply cannot offer.

For buyers evaluating 3 BHK, 3.5 BHK or 4 BHK homes, understanding how these amenities are distributed is an important part of comparing Heart of Harmony with other projects on Hosur Road. To get the full picture, contact the Heart of Harmony sales team for a site visit where you can see both levels firsthand.
Frequently Asked Questions

items.q: What amenities does Heart of Harmony have?
items.a: Heart of Harmony amenities include 40+ facilities across two levels — the vehicle-free podium and the rooftop terrace clubhouse. Podium (outdoor): pickleball court, basketball practice court, outdoor gym, jogging track, bicycle track, rock climbing wall, multipurpose courts, table tennis, tot lot, amphitheatre, sunken seating with campfire, sky deck, nature trail, reflexology path, sculpture court, shaded plazas, pet park, children’s play area. Clubhouse (rooftop): sky deck swimming pool with paddle pool and lazy pool, spa, sauna and steam, jacuzzi, ice bath, fully equipped gymnasium, banquet hall with kitchen, co-working space, multipurpose activity room, indoor games, yoga and meditation zone. items.q: Does Heart of Harmony have a swimming pool?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony has a sky deck swimming pool on the rooftop clubhouse level, along with a paddle pool and lazy pool. The pool offers panoramic views of South Bengaluru’s skyline — shared by just 137 homes across 24 floors.

items.q: Is there a spa and sauna at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Yes. The Heart of Harmony rooftop clubhouse includes a full spa, sauna and steam room, and ice bath — hotel-standard wellness facilities exclusively for residents.

items.q: Does Heart of Harmony have a pickleball court?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony has a dedicated pickleball court on the vehicle-free podium level, along with a basketball practice court, outdoor gym, jogging track, bicycle track, and rock climbing wall.

items.q: Is there a co-working space at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Yes. Heart of Harmony includes a dedicated co-working space in the rooftop clubhouse — designed for residents who work from home 2–3 days a week and need a productive, distraction-free environment close to home.

items.q: Does Heart of Harmony have a banquet hall?
items.a: Yes. A banquet hall with a full kitchen and pre-function area is part of the Heart of Harmony clubhouse amenities, available for resident events, private functions, and community gatherings.

items.q: How many levels of amenities does Heart of Harmony have?
items.a: Two levels — the vehicle-free podium for all outdoor sports, social, and leisure amenities, and the rooftop terrace clubhouse for the pool, gym, spa, wellness suite, banquet hall, and co-working space. Both levels are accessible to all 137 residents.

items.q: Is there a gym at Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Yes. A fully equipped gymnasium is part of the Heart of Harmony rooftop terrace clubhouse on the topmost level of the 24-floor tower, with views across South Bengaluru.

items.q: What is the closest metro to Heart of Harmony?
items.a: Kudlu Gate Metro Station on the Yellow Line (Namma Metro) is just 400 metres from Heart of Harmony on Hosur Main Road — approximately 5 to 8 minutes on foot. The Yellow Line connects to Jayadeva Hospital (interchange with the Green Line), Dairy Circle, and Bommasandra (Electronic City).
